item.title: Fortran_Tales = .gone_wrong.
item.description: Lab 1 (Pascal Triangle) Bad bad. It was bad. It was soooo bad that I don’t even remember anyth from Lab 1, except “Hello world”? Here’s a link to a nice introductory tutorial on Fortran if you too got unlucky enough in your undergrad life. And then we were given an home task to ouput a Pascal Triangle (using Binomial coefficients): program pascal implicit none integer::i,j,c do i=1,7 c = 1 do j=1,i write(*, "(I10)", advance="no") c c = (c * (i - j)) / j end do write(*,*) end do end program Output:
